name: PEMPO AI Discovery – Boost LLM Traffic from ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews & More
author: Josh J

sections.description:
PEMPO turns your existing WordPress content into AI‑ready sources that get pulled into answers. It helps ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and Claude find, understand and cite your posts—so you earn traffic from AI search, not just blue links.

This is SEO for AI, not AI for SEO. We don’t generate copy or spin titles. Instead, PEMPO structures your content so large language models can parse facts, FAQs, claims and attribution—complete with citations you control.

Install and go. PEMPO automatically injects standards‑compliant JSON‑LD, semantic text chunks and verification data, and cleans distracting widgets. It works alongside Yoast, Rank Math and AIOSEO without changing your theme or workflow.

The PEMPO Dashboard shows you exactly how AI sees your site—grading both individual posts and your entire domain. See detailed counts of the elements LLMs value most: FAQs, citations, semantic chunks, and named entities. Instantly spot weak spots, fix them, and watch your grades climb to A.

Key Features

  • Instant AI optimization for all your content — no setup needed
  • Automatic JSON-LD schema injection for facts, FAQs, and claims
  • Citation customization with publication name, style, and credibility
  • Content filtering removes promotional clutter for clearer AI parsing
  • Semantic chunking to help AI pinpoint key information
  • Live AI Readiness Dashboard with detailed grading and actionable insights
  • Compatible with any theme and popular SEO plugins like Yoast & RankMath
  • Lightweight and fast with zero external requests

How It Works for You

PEMPO works silently in the background, embedding rich metadata that AI models instantly understand. When ChatGPT or Google AI Overviews crawl your posts, they see exactly who authored the content, when it was published, and the key points you want highlighted. This increases your chances of being cited accurately and prominently in AI-generated answers.

Technical Specs

  • Uses Schema.org JSON-LD for structured data markup
  • No external API calls or performance impact
  • Semantic text chunking for precise AI citations
  • Author and publication credibility signals
  • Fact-checking metadata to boost source trustworthiness
  • Fully compatible with existing SEO tools and workflows
sections.installation:
1. Install from WordPress Plugin Directory
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Done! Your content is now AI-optimized
sections.faq:
Does this slow down my site?

No. PEMPO is extremely lightweight with no external requests or render‑blocking scripts.

Will this work with my current SEO setup?

Yes! PEMPO is designed to work alongside Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO, and other SEO plugins. It focuses on AI discoverability (SEO for AI) rather than traditional keyword optimization.

How do I know it’s working?

Open the PEMPO Dashboard to see your AI Readiness Score, per‑post grades, and detailed counts for FAQs, claims, semantic chunks, and entities. You can also view your page source to confirm JSON‑LD schema or test with Google’s Rich Results validator.

Can I customize citations?

Yes! In PEMPO Settings, set your publication name, preferred citation style (academic, journalism, web), and source credibility level.

What content gets filtered?

PEMPO automatically removes promotional widgets, newsletter popups, and ad clutter that can confuse AI parsers.

Where does the schema appear?

In the HTML head of single posts and pages, as a <script type="application/ld+json"> tag containing FAQs, claims, semantic chunks, and entity data.

Can I export schema?

Yes. From the PEMPO Dashboard, you can one‑click export clean JSON‑LD for any post to inspect, archive, or share.

What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)?

GEO is the practice of optimizing content for AI‑powered search engines and large language models. Unlike traditional SEO, which focuses on rankings in Google’s blue links, GEO ensures your content gets cited and referenced by ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and other AI systems. Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) is a subset of GEO focused on Q&A pairings.
